mood.label: CAUTIOUS
mood.line: Prices are rising too fast, so the Fed may raise rates.

assets.why: Stocks tend to stall while the economy loses speed.
Gold usually falls while bonds still pay well after inflation.
The dollar usually rises as worried money parks in US savings.
Bond payouts usually rise while prices are still climbing fast.

bullets: Prices: falling about 3.4% a year. The Fed wants 2%.
Jobs: hiring is steady at about +51K a month.
Next big date: Weekly jobless claims on Oct 15.

changed.line: The bond market picture cooled this month. The mood is now cautious.
